remarks: Welcome to 3062 Cloverbank Road in Hamburg, NY, offering the space, storage and updates that can be hard to find in one property. With 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths and 1,876 square feet, this home provides generous living space along with ample closets and storage throughout. The finished lower level provides even more usable space, ideal for a game room, rec room, home office or additional living area. The heated garage with workbench provides additional storage and functionality. Outside, a fully fenced backyard and stamped concrete patio add valuable outdoor living space. Located in the Frontier Central School District, this Hamburg property offers convenient access to shopping, restaurants, everyday amenities and major routes. Cloverbank Road is well maintained during the winter months, and the new Highmark Stadium is just minutes away, putting Buffalo Bills football close to home. Go Bills! Since 2021, the property has received numerous improvements, including newer carpeting throughout most of the home, updated windows, hot water tank, water softener, sump pump, humidifier, driveway improvements, updated front porch supports, professional duct cleaning, and professional servicing of the furnace and central air. With 4 bedrooms, a fully fenced yard, finished lower level, heated garage, central air, abundant storage and a convenient Hamburg location, 3062 Cloverbank Road brings together space, updates and location in one well maintained property.
